reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official Conversation MP3, current audio hash, alignment and rights checks must pass; no silent directions as evidence.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Same source reading and audio share one exposure group; never count either as unseen after the other.

questions.prompt: At what morning time had Anna and Pete agreed to meet? Write the time as H:MM.
questions.evidence: we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together.
questions.explanation: Anna明确说双方约好早上8:00碰面一起上班，Pete的讲述也沿用8:00。题目已说明morning并要求H:MM，所以填8:00，不需要再加a.m.。43分钟是到咨询师那里迟到的时长，不是约定时刻。

spokenEvidence.quote: we decided to meet at 8:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m. to come to work together.

questions.prompt: What does Kelly ask Anna and Pete to do when they both start explaining?
options: Leave and return the following day.
questions.evidence: You can’t both talk at the same time. You have to take turns.
questions.explanation: Kelly说两人不能同时讲话，必须take turns，也就是轮流说。她没有要求改成默写，也没有让他们第二天再来。这个要求针对交流方式，不是在裁定谁的迟到解释一定真实。

spokenEvidence.quote: You can’t both talk at the same time. You have to take turns.

questions.prompt: According to Anna’s account, what did Pete waste time waiting for?
questions.evidence: After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.
questions.explanation: 按照Anna的版本，Pete等咖啡浪费时间。题干特意限定According to Anna’s account，因为Pete接着会给出另一种解释；有这句话不等于读者已能判定真实的全部原因。

spokenEvidence.quote: After Pete had wasted time waiting for coffee, we were late.

questions.prompt: According to Pete, which way of travelling added time to their commute?
questions.evidence: I always walk to work. But she said that would take too long and that a scooter would be much faster. It was awful. I hated it. And it added too much time to our commute!
questions.explanation: Pete说自己平常走路，Anna却建议更快的scooter；随后他用it added too much time抱怨这次代步方式增加通勤时间。这里问Pete的叙述，不采用Anna等咖啡的版本，也不凭外部交通常识判断滑板车一定更快或更慢。

spokenEvidence.quote: I always walk to work. But she said that would take too long and that a scooter would be much faster. It was awful. I hated it. And it added too much time to our commute!

questions.prompt: How does Kelly respond when Anna says she left a message?
options: She says she has already replied.
She says she did not receive it.
She says Pete read it to her.
answers: She says she did not receive it.
questions.evidence: Hum. I didn’t get that message.
questions.explanation: Kelly说didn’t get that message，能确认的是她表示没有收到。文中没有交代发送失败的技术原因，也没有说她回过信或让Pete转读。不要把没有收到扩大解释成Anna故意没有通知。

spokenEvidence.quote: Hum. I didn’t get that message.

questions.prompt: How does Kelly want to use Anna and Pete’s differences in the new show?
options: Let only one of them report every story.
Have them agree on a single version before speaking.
Have each present a different point of view on a story.
answers: Have each present a different point of view on a story.
questions.evidence: For every story, you tell a different point of view.
questions.explanation: Kelly认为不同观察角度可以成为节目的特色，要求每则故事呈现不同观点。因此不是只让一个人说，也不是先消除所有差异。题目考节目安排，不问节目名称，避免把标题提示直接当答案。

spokenEvidence.quote: For every story, you tell a different point of view.

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item source comparison; not human or psychometric calibration

blindComparison.scope: Source text only; not an actual listening check, human examiner review or difficulty calibration.
